entities.name: Nadia Bey
entities.description: Young monster slayer on Innistrad and lady of Bey Manor, trained by her uncle.

entities.name: Master Bey
entities.description: Nadia's strict uncle and trainer who tested her with undead attackers.

events.summary: Nadia and Master Bey destroy a nest of devils and she injures her hand.
events.quote: to destroy a nest of devils

events.summary: Nadia battles undead attackers in her room, a scenario her uncle set up to test her, and destroys a powerful skaab with a holy spell.
events.quote: used a holy spell to destroy the biggest attacker, a powerful skaab

events.summary: Nadia assists in burying the corpses as her uncle ordered.
events.quote: Nadia followed her uncle's orders to assist in handling and properly burying the corpses of the attackers

relations.quote: Her uncle, Master Bey , trained her to survive Innistrad 's threats.
Nadia deeply respects her uncle, Master Bey
